note: Truth state of site capabilities at build time. Values are evidence-labelled: VERIFIED (measured this lane) or UNMEASURED (not fabricated). Maturity ladder: PRESENT→LOADABLE→BUILDABLE→REACHABLE→USABLE→ACCESSIBLE→PROVEN.

maturity_ladder.USABLE: core content complete without JS, navigation works
maturity_ladder.PROVEN: 200 + content correct + mobile correct + keyboard accessible + no-JS readable + no overflow + visual QA + no broken links + metadata correct + structured data + sitemap/llms updated + confidentiality check + performance measured + deployment receipt

evidence.no_js_content: VERIFIED (route-stamped shell + full React content at hydration)
evidence.mobile_visual_qa: UNMEASURED (screenshots exist at /tmp/afz-shots/ but this model cannot view images)

evidence.table_nojs_readable: VERIFIED (static shell contains route h1 + description; full table at hydration)

evidence.surfaces_json: VERIFIED (+4 work routes in all 3 copies: root, public, dist)
evidence.web_canon_verify: UNMEASURED (verifier absent on KVM4 — af-forge only)

dual_copy_law_note: surfaces.json root copy is overwritten from public/ by every build. Both copies must be edited together. Verified byte-identical post-build 2026-10-02.
